title: Qt: Start to use nstime_t in IO Graph
description:
Keep the offset between absolute time and relative time in an
IO Graph in an nstime_t for longer. We can convert the offset to
a double outside the loop so this is no less efficient. This avoids
losing precision.

The next steps are to also use a nstime_t in IOGraphDialog, and
to change the AxisTicker so that instead of adding the offset to
all the data (and losing precision), the offset is only used when
generating the tick labels. That would have the advantage of not
having to recalculate all the data when changing the label type.

Related to #13682
